dialogues.jp: 眠気を十分に消化して、自然と目が覚める。
dialogues.en: As soon as I shoke off my drowsiness, I opened my eyes.
dialogues.text: As soon as I shoke off my drowsiness, I opened my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
時計を見ると、これから出掛けるには、丁度い
い感じの時刻だった。
dialogues.en:
A quick look at the clock told me it was the perfect time to
get up and take a walk somewhere.
dialogues.text:
A quick look at the clock told me it was the perfect time to
get up and take a walk somewhere.

dialogues.jp:
「せっかくの日曜だし、出掛けるのも悪くない
　かな」
dialogues.en: "It'd be a waste not to go out on this long-awaited Sunday."
dialogues.text: "It'd be a waste not to go out on this long-awaited Sunday."

dialogues.jp:
俺はのそりと起き上がり、私服に着替えると、
部屋を出た。
dialogues.en:
I rose from my bed, changed into my normal clothes, and left
my room.
dialogues.text:
I rose from my bed, changed into my normal clothes, and left
my room.

dialogues.jp:
日曜だが、早起きに慣れていたせいか、十分に
眠気を消化して、遅くない時間に起きた。
dialogues.en:
Due to having woken up early so often during the week, I
ended up waking up early as well on this Sunday.
dialogues.text:
Due to having woken up early so often during the week, I
ended up waking up early as well on this Sunday.

dialogues.jp: せっかくだし、どこかへ出かけることにした。
dialogues.en: I decide to make use of this extra time and go somewhere.
dialogues.text: I decide to make use of this extra time and go somewhere.
